Create a photorealistic product mockup of a printed paperback book standing slightly angled, turned a little to the LEFT so that we see the front cover and the white page edges on the RIGHT side of the book. The spine is NOT visible: no spine, no back cover and no text anywhere except the front cover. Physically correct perspective like a real product photo on a pure white background, soft natural shadow under it. The book fills about 75% of the frame height and is fully visible, nothing cropped.
FRONT COVER DESIGN - "two colleagues": deep navy background with soft electric blue light. In the middle a woman about 45 and a man about 50 in smart casual office clothes sitting side by side at a desk with one laptop, both smiling at the screen, a soft glowing blue stream of light and small floating chat bubbles coming out of the laptop; photorealistic. Title "AI ЗА РАБОТА" in white at the top, "2027" in big amber.
TEXT ON THE COVER (exactly these lines, nothing else):
1) Title line 1, huge: "AI ЗА РАБОТА"
2) Big year next to or under the title, amber: "2027"
3) Subtitle, smaller, 3-4 lines: "Свърши до 10 пъти по-бързо имейлите, отчетите, таблиците и презентациите с ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude и Copilot, дори да нямаш предишен опит или технически умения."
4) Author name at the bottom of the cover, medium, white or light: "ДАНИЕЛА ПЕТРОВА"
5) Publisher mark at the very bottom centre, small: a simple golden key icon followed by the words "ЗЛАТЕН КЛЮЧ"

- All text is Bulgarian Cyrillic except "AI", "T.I.M.E.", "ChatGPT", "Gemini", "Claude" and "Copilot". Render every text line EXACTLY as given, character by character, including punctuation. Do not translate, correct, shorten, re-order or add any words.
- Heavy, clean modern sans-serif with full Cyrillic (Montserrat ExtraBold / Black style) for titles; clean regular sans-serif for the subtitle. Large and clearly legible on a phone.
- No other text, other logos, watermarks, prices or website addresses anywhere; screens show no readable text.
STYLE: premium, modern, confident, clean professional business-book design like a bestselling publisher would use, NOT childish, NOT clip-art, NOT sci-fi robots, NOT scary. Palette: deep navy blue #1B2F4E, bright electric blue #2F80ED, warm amber #F2A93B and white.
People on the cover are ordinary Bulgarian office workers about 40-55 years old (not models), natural friendly faces, hands with five fingers.
